````ts
// rp.n8.midi-to-fifo (src/script/nodes/n8MidiToFifo.ts): every routed MIDI message, whole, to a NES core's MIDI input
// and its N8 FIFO. The nes-n8-midi case of test/dsp/roles.test.ts, which drives the role through the kernel, at the
// node.
import { test, expect } from "../../../testing/harness";
import { N8_MIDI_TO_FIFO_NODE_TYPE, n8MidiToFifoNode } from "../../../src/script/nodes/n8MidiToFifo";
import { NodeRig, on } from "./_rig";

test("its routed MIDI in as midiIn, out as midi, the system node's input of that name, sized as the kernel's", () => {
  const rig = new NodeRig(n8MidiToFifoNode);
  expect(rig.ports()).toEqual(["in events midiIn", "out events midi"]);
  expect(n8MidiToFifoNode.descriptor().id).toBe(N8_MIDI_TO_FIFO_NODE_TYPE);
  expect(n8MidiToFifoNode.layout({} as never).ports[1].capacity).toEqual({ messages: 4096, bytes: 73728 });
  expect(n8MidiToFifoNode.reshapes).toBe(true);
});

test("nes-n8-midi forwards each routed MIDI message to its system's core, whole", () => {
  const sent = new NodeRig(n8MidiToFifoNode).run({ frames: 22050, inputs: { midiIn: [{ frame: 0, data: [0x90, 60, 100] }] } });
  // The whole message crosses as one (the NES core fans the bytes into the N8 FIFO), and nothing goes anywhere else.
  expect(sent).toEqual([{ port: "midi", frame: 0, queued: 0, data: [0x90, 60, 100], flags: 0 }]);
});

test("every message goes on as it came, in order, SysEx whole", () => {
  const sysex = [0xf0, 0x7d, ...Array.from({ length: 512 }, (_, i) => i & 0x7f), 0xf7];
  const sent = new NodeRig(n8MidiToFifoNode).run({
    frames: 1024,
    inputs: { midiIn: [{ frame: 3, data: [0x91, 62, 80] }, { frame: 3, data: sysex }, { frame: 1023, data: [0x81, 62, 0] }] },
  });
  expect(on(sent, "midi")).toEqual([[3, 0x91, 62, 80], [3, ...sysex], [1023, 0x81, 62, 0]]);
});
````

Create `packages/retroplug/test/script/nodes/risa-sync.test.ts`:

````ts
// rp.risa.sync (src/script/nodes/risaSync.ts): the DAW transport as risa's N8-FIFO host-sync byte protocol (arm+locate,
// start, 24-PPQN clock, stop) on its `bytes` output. The role cases of test/dsp/risa-sync.test.ts, which drives the
// role through the kernel, at the node; the protocol's pure cases stay there.
// Protocol reference: risa's docs/sync/host-sync-protocol.md (2.3.0 and later).
import { test, expect } from "../../../testing/harness";
import { RISA_SYNC_NODE_TYPE, risaSyncNode } from "../../../src/script/nodes/risaSync";
import { NodeRig, type BlockSpec, type Sent } from "./_rig";

const risa = () => new NodeRig(risaSyncNode);
// 22050 frames @ 44100 / 120 bpm = exactly 1 beat (24 ticks at 24 PPQN).
const beat = (over: Partial<BlockSpec> = {}): BlockSpec => ({ frames: 22050, ...over });
const packets = (sent: Sent[]): number[][] => sent.filter((s) => s.port === "bytes").map((s) => s.data);
const clocks = (sent: Sent[]): number => sent.filter((s) => s.data.length === 1 && s.data[0] === 0xf8).length;
const arms = (sent: Sent[]) => sent.filter((s) => s.data[0] === 0xf9);

test("one output, the core's byte input, sized as the kernel's core-bytes port; no settings", () => {
  const rig = risa();
  expect(rig.ports()).toEqual(["out bytes bytes"]);
  expect(risaSyncNode.descriptor().id).toBe(RISA_SYNC_NODE_TYPE);
  expect(risaSyncNode.descriptor().settings).toEqual({ type: "object" });
  expect(risaSyncNode.layout({} as never).ports[0].capacity).toEqual({ messages: 256, bytes: 1024 });
  expect(risaSyncNode.reshapes).toBe(true);
});

test("idle (transport off) emits nothing", () => {
  expect(risa().run(beat())).toEqual([]);
});

test("transport rise arms+locates from ppqStart, starts, then streams the beat's remaining clocks", () => {
  const out = risa().run(beat({ playing: true })); // ppqStart 0 → clock 0
  const p = packets(out);
  expect(p[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]); // F9 52: arm+locate song 0 chain 0 tick 0
  expect(p[1]).toEqual([0xfa]); // FA: start
  // 23, not 24: risa primes the armed clock itself, and an F8 for it would double-advance the row.
  expect(clocks(out)).toBe(23);
});

test("the arm is a barrier: it flushes the FIFO, the start and clocks do not", () => {
  const out = risa().run(beat({ playing: true }));
  expect(arms(out).length).toBe(1);
  expect(arms(out)[0].flags).toBe(1);
  expect(out.filter((s) => s.data[0] !== 0xf9).every((s) => s.flags === 0)).toBe(true);
});

test("clocks go out at their ticks' frames, after the arm and start at frame 0", () => {
  const out = risa().run(beat({ playing: true }));
  expect(out.slice(0, 2).map((s) => s.frame)).toEqual([0, 0]);
  // The first clock is tick 1 (tick 0 is primed): 22050 / 24 frames in.
  expect(out.slice(2, 5).map((s) => s.frame)).toEqual([918, 1837, 2756]);
});

test("a mid-song start locates from the current ppq (song row / chain row / tick offset)", () => {
  // ppq 64 → clock 1536 → phrase 16 → song 1, chain 0, tick 0.
  expect(packets(risa().run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 64 })))[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00]);
  // ppq 5 → clock 120 → phrase 1 (song 0, chain 1), tick 120-96 = 24 into the phrase.
  expect(packets(risa().run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 5 })))[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x00, 0x01, 24]);
  // The last grid position in a phrase: clock 95 → tick 0x5f, the protocol's documented maximum.
  expect(packets(risa().run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 95 / 24 })))[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x00, 0x00, 0x5f]);
});

test("a locate onto a non-grid ppq keeps the tick offset exact, and suppresses no clock", () => {
  // ppq 0.25 → clock 6 exactly: on the six-clock grid, so that clock is the primed one.
  const onGrid = risa().run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 0.25 }));
  expect(packets(onGrid)[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x00, 0x00, 6]);
  expect(clocks(onGrid)).toBe(23); // clock 6 primed, so one fewer than the beat's 24
  // ppq 0.26 → clock floor(6.24) = 6 armed, but the first clock in the block is 7: nothing to suppress.
  const offGrid = risa().run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 0.26 }));
  expect(packets(offGrid)[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x00, 0x00, 6]);
  expect(clocks(offGrid)).toBe(24);
});

test("continued playback streams clocks with no new arm/start", () => {
  const rig = risa();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true })); // rise at ppq 0 (ppqEnd → 1)
  const cont = rig.run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 1 })); // contiguous
  expect(cont.some((s) => s.data[0] === 0xf9 || s.data[0] === 0xfa)).toBeFalsy(); // no re-arm
  expect(clocks(cont)).toBe(24); // a full beat: only the block carrying the arm loses a clock
});

test("a ppq discontinuity (seek/loop) re-arms at the new position", () => {
  const rig = risa();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true })); // rise at ppq 0
  const seek = rig.run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 64 })); // jumped to phrase 16
  expect(packets(seek)[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00]); // fresh arm at song 1 chain 0
  expect(packets(seek)[1]).toEqual([0xfa]);
  expect(arms(seek)[0].flags).toBe(1); // the re-arm discards clocks queued for the old position
  expect(clocks(seek)).toBe(23); // its own armed clock is primed too
});

test("a loop back to the SAME position re-arms and re-primes that clock", () => {
  const rig = risa();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 4 })); // rise at phrase 1
  const loop = rig.run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 4 })); // looped back to it
  expect(packets(loop)[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00]);
  expect(clocks(loop)).toBe(23);
});

test("transport fall stops (FC) with no clocks", () => {
  const rig = risa();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true })); // playing
  expect(packets(rig.run(beat({ playing: false, ppq: 1 })))).toEqual([[0xfc]]); // fell
});

test("a stop then a restart at the same position arms again and re-primes", () => {
  const rig = risa();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true })); // rise at ppq 0
  rig.run(beat({ playing: false, ppq: 1 })); // stop
  const again = rig.run(beat({ playing: true })); // start over at ppq 0
  expect(packets(again)[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]);
  expect(packets(again)[1]).toEqual([0xfa]);
  expect(clocks(again)).toBe(23);
});

test("the song row wraps at 0x7f and the chain row at 0x0f, as the protocol's masks require", () => {
  // phrase 0x7ff → songRow (0x7ff >> 4) & 0x7f = 0x7f, chainRow 0x0f. ppq = phrase * 4.
  expect(packets(risa().run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 0x7ff * 4 })))[0]).toEqual([0xf9, 0x52, 0x7f, 0x0f, 0x00]);
});

test("1-frame blocks clock the same stream as one block does", () => {
  const whole = risa().run(beat({ playing: true }));
  const rig = risa();
  const pieces: number[][] = [];
  for (let f = 0; f < 22050; f++) for (const s of rig.run({ frames: 1, playing: true, ppq: f / 22050 })) pieces.push(s.data);
  expect(pieces).toEqual(packets(whole));
});
````

Create `packages/retroplug/test/script/nodes/sms-sync.test.ts`:

````ts
// rp.sms.sync (src/script/nodes/smsSync.ts): the DAW transport as smsggdj's sync transport, a 2-bit counter held on
// two port lines at 24 PPQN, each step a LEVEL WORD on its `bytes` output. Both machines: a Master System's controller
// port 2 (TR + TH), a Game Gear's EXT port (PC4/PC5 + PC6), picked by `machine`. The role cases of
// test/dsp/sms-sync.test.ts, which drives the role through the kernel, at the node; the encoding's pure cases and the
// ROM provider's stay there.
//
// Protocol reference: smsggdj's GGSYNC.md and src/engine.asm:576-590 / :646-661.
import { test, expect } from "../../../testing/harness";
import { SMS_SYNC_NODE_TYPE, smsSyncNode } from "../../../src/script/nodes/smsSync";
import { ggSyncLevels, smsSyncLevels, SMS_SYNC_MAX_CLOCKS_PER_POLL, SMS_SYNC_PPQN } from "../../../src/smsSync";
import { NodeRig, type BlockSpec, type Sent } from "./_rig";

const machine = (m: "sms" | "gg") => new NodeRig(smsSyncNode, { machine: m });
const sms = () => machine("sms");
const gg = () => machine("gg");
// 22050 frames @ 44100 / 120 bpm = exactly 1 beat (24 ticks at 24 PPQN).
const beat = (over: Partial<BlockSpec> = {}): BlockSpec => ({ frames: 22050, ...over });
const levels = (sent: Sent[]): number[] => sent.map((s) => s.data[0]);

test("one output, the core's byte input, sized as the kernel's core-bytes port; machine defaults to sms", () => {
  expect(sms().ports()).toEqual(["out bytes bytes"]);
  expect(smsSyncNode.descriptor().id).toBe(SMS_SYNC_NODE_TYPE);
  expect(smsSyncNode.parseSettings({})).toEqual({ machine: "sms" });
  expect(() => smsSyncNode.parseSettings({ machine: "md" })).toThrow("machine: Invalid option");
  expect(smsSyncNode.layout(smsSyncNode.parseSettings({})).ports[0].capacity).toEqual({ messages: 256, bytes: 1024 });
  expect(smsSyncNode.reshapes).toBe(true);
});

test("idle (transport off) emits nothing", () => {
  expect(sms().run(beat())).toEqual([]);
});

test("transport emits one level per 24-PPQN tick, no arm and no start message", () => {
  const out = sms().run(beat({ playing: true }));
  // 24, not 23: unlike risa there is no armed clock the ROM primes itself, so none is withheld.
  expect(out.length).toBe(SMS_SYNC_PPQN);
  // Every payload is a single level word - nothing that could be mistaken for a protocol byte.
  for (const s of out) expect(s.data.length).toBe(1);
});

test("the counter ADVANCES one step per tick and wraps - the ROM reads deltas, not absolutes", () => {
  const want: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= SMS_SYNC_PPQN; i++) want.push(smsSyncLevels(i));
  expect(levels(sms().run(beat({ playing: true })))).toEqual(want);
});

test("no level is ever repeated back-to-back, or the ROM would read a delta of zero", () => {
  const seq = levels(sms().run(beat({ playing: true })));
  expect(seq.filter((v, i) => i > 0 && v === seq[i - 1]).length).toBe(0);
});

test("the counter carries across blocks rather than restarting", () => {
  const rig = sms();
  const a = levels(rig.run(beat({ playing: true })));
  const b = levels(rig.run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 1 })));
  // The first tick of block 2 must still step the counter: restarting it would repeat a level across the boundary.
  expect(b[0] === a[a.length - 1]).toBeFalsy();
  expect(b[0]).toBe(smsSyncLevels(SMS_SYNC_PPQN + 1));
});

test("no flush is ever requested - a held level has no undelivered-stream hazard", () => {
  for (const s of sms().run(beat({ playing: true }))) expect(s.flags).toBe(0);
});

test("stop is implicit: clocks simply cease, with no stop message", () => {
  const rig = sms();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true }));
  expect(rig.run(beat({ playing: false, ppq: 1 }))).toEqual([]); // not "one stop byte" - nothing at all
});

test("a seek does NOT relocate: the node is positionless by design", () => {
  const rig = sms();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true }));
  const out = rig.run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 64 })); // big jump
  expect(out.length).toBe(SMS_SYNC_PPQN);
  for (const s of out) expect(s.data.length).toBe(1); // no arm packet appeared
});

test("ticks land at spread sample offsets, not bunched at block start", () => {
  const frames = sms().run(beat({ playing: true })).map((s) => s.frame);
  expect(new Set(frames).size).toBe(frames.length); // strictly distinct
  expect(frames.filter((f, i) => i > 0 && f <= frames[i - 1]).length).toBe(0); // strictly ascending
  expect(frames.filter((f) => f < 0 || f >= 22050).length).toBe(0); // all inside the block
});

test("the documented aliasing ceiling matches the tempo the node can actually clock", () => {
  const ntscFps = 59.9227434;
  expect(Math.round((SMS_SYNC_MAX_CLOCKS_PER_POLL * ntscFps * 60) / SMS_SYNC_PPQN)).toBe(449);
  // At the ceiling a block still yields more clocks than a beat's worth: the limit is the ROM's poll rate.
  expect(sms().run(beat({ playing: true, tempo: 449 })).length > SMS_SYNC_PPQN).toBeTruthy();
});

test("a gg node emits GG level words at the same 24 PPQN cadence", () => {
  const got = levels(gg().run(beat({ playing: true })));
  expect(got.length).toBe(SMS_SYNC_PPQN);
  expect(got[0]).toBe(ggSyncLevels(1));
  expect(got[1]).toBe(ggSyncLevels(2));
  expect(got[3]).toBe(ggSyncLevels(0));
  // ...and nothing in the stream is an SMS word: those set bit 7, which is not a GG pin at all.
  expect(got.some((v) => (v & 0x80) !== 0)).toBeFalsy();
});

test("a machine change keeps the counter and the clock, and encodes the next step on the new pins", () => {
  const rig = sms();
  rig.run(beat({ playing: true }));
  expect(rig.set({ machine: "gg" })).toBe(true);
  const next = levels(rig.run(beat({ playing: true, ppq: 1 })));
  expect(next.length).toBe(SMS_SYNC_PPQN);
  expect(next[0]).toBe(ggSyncLevels(SMS_SYNC_PPQN + 1));
  expect(rig.creates).toBe(1);
});
````

Create `packages/retroplug/test/script/nodes/lsdj-sync.test.ts`:

````ts
// rp.lsdj.sync (src/script/nodes/lsdjSync.ts): LSDj's sync modes, as the lsdj-sync role ran them. The role cases of
// test/dsp/lsdj-modes.test.ts and test/dsp/roles.test.ts, and the kernel-level MI.OUT and master-sync cases of
// test/dsp/lsdj-arduinoboy.test.ts (whose pure decoder cases stay there), at the node; with what the kernel node's own
// tests held of the serial-in runs and the feedback wire's frames (test/script/kernel-node.test.ts).
import { test, expect } from "../../../testing/harness";
import { LSDJ_SYNC_NODE_TYPE, lsdjSyncNode } from "../../../src/script/nodes/lsdjSync";
import { NodeRig, bytesOn, on, type BlockSpec, type In, type Sent } from "./_rig";

const lsdj = (mode: string, config: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => new NodeRig(lsdjSyncNode, { mode, ...config });
// 22050 frames @ 44100 / 120 = exactly 1 beat (24 ticks at 24 PPQN).
const beat = (over: Partial<BlockSpec> = {}): BlockSpec => ({ frames: 22050, ...over });
const withMidi = (midi: In[], over: Partial<BlockSpec> = {}): BlockSpec => beat({ ...over, inputs: { midi, ...over.inputs } });
const noteOn = (channel: number, note: number, frame = 0): In => ({ frame, data: [0x90 | channel, note, 100] });
const noteOff = (channel: number, note: number, frame = 0): In => ({ frame, data: [0x80 | channel, note, 0] });
const serial = (sent: Sent[]): number[] => bytesOn(sent, "serialIn").map(([, b]) => b);
const clocks = (sent: Sent[]): number => serial(sent).filter((b) => b === 0xf8).length;
const midiOut = (sent: Sent[]): number[][] => sent.filter((s) => s.port === "midiOut").map((s) => s.data);

test("its ports: the routed MIDI, the launches and the Game Boy's serial out in; serial in, buttons and MIDI out", () => {
  expect(lsdj("midiSync").ports()).toEqual([
    "in events midi",
    "in events launches",
    "in bytes serialOut",
    "out bytes serialIn",
    "out events buttons",
    "out events midiOut",
  ]);
  expect(lsdjSyncNode.descriptor().id).toBe(LSDJ_SYNC_NODE_TYPE);
  const caps = lsdjSyncNode.layout(lsdjSyncNode.parseSettings({})).ports.slice(3).map((p) => p.capacity);
  expect(caps).toEqual([{ messages: 4096, bytes: 73728 }, { messages: 64, bytes: 128 }, { messages: 1024, bytes: 8192 }]);
  expect(lsdjSyncNode.reshapes).toBe(true);
});

test("settings default as the role's schema does, and refuse what it would clamp", () => {
  expect(lsdjSyncNode.parseSettings({})).toEqual({ mode: "midiSync", tempoDivisor: 1, autoStart: false });
  expect(() => lsdjSyncNode.parseSettings({ mode: "sync" })).toThrow("mode: Invalid option");
  expect(() => lsdjSyncNode.parseSettings({ tempoDivisor: 9 })).toThrow("tempoDivisor: Too big");
  expect(() => lsdjSyncNode.parseSettings({ autoStart: 1 })).toThrow("autoStart: Invalid input");
});

test("MidiSync emits a 24-PPQN 0xF8 clock at its ticks' frames; Off emits nothing", () => {
  const on = lsdj("midiSync").run(beat({ playing: true }));
  expect(clocks(on)).toBe(24);
  expect(bytesOn(on, "serialIn").slice(0, 3)).toEqual([[0, 0xf8], [918, 0xf8], [1837, 0xf8]]);
  expect(lsdj("off").run(beat({ playing: true }))).toEqual([]);
  expect(lsdj("keyboard").run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 60)], { playing: true }))).toEqual([]);
});

test("MidiSync's tempo divisor subdivides the clock, and its auto-arm taps START on the transport's rise", () => {
  expect(clocks(lsdj("midiSync", { tempoDivisor: 4 }).run(beat({ playing: true })))).toBe(6);
  const rig = lsdj("midiSync", { autoStart: true });
  const press = (sent: Sent[]) => on(sent, "buttons");
  expect(press(rig.run({ frames: 1024 }))).toEqual([]);
  expect(press(rig.run({ frames: 1024, playing: true }))).toEqual([[0, 7, 1]]); // pressed for 2 blocks...
  expect(press(rig.run({ frames: 1024, playing: true, ppq: 0.05 }))).toEqual([]);
  expect(press(rig.run({ frames: 1024, playing: true, ppq: 0.1 }))).toEqual([[0, 7, 0]]); // ...then released
  expect(press(rig.run({ frames: 1024, playing: true, ppq: 0.15 }))).toEqual([]);
});

test("MidiPassthrough forwards raw MIDI bytes verbatim to serial", () => {
  expect(serial(lsdj("midiPassthrough").run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 60)])))).toEqual([0x90, 60, 100]);
});

test("MidiMap: ch0 NoteOn → row byte, matching NoteOff → 0xFE, ch1 → row+128 (lastRow persists across blocks)", () => {
  const rig = lsdj("midiMap");
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 5)])))).toEqual([5]); // ch0 note 5 → row 5
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOff(0, 5)])))).toEqual([0xfe]); // matching off → sentinel
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOff(0, 9)])))).toEqual([]); // non-matching off → nothing
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(1, 5)])))).toEqual([133]); // ch1 note 5 → 5 + 128
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(2, 5)])))).toEqual([]); // other channels are no row
});

test("MidiMap clocks the cart with 0xFF at frame 0 while the transport plays, after the rows", () => {
  const sent = lsdj("midiMap").run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 3, 500)], { playing: true }));
  const got = bytesOn(sent, "serialIn");
  expect(got[0]).toEqual([500, 3]);
  // Each clock is sent at frame 0, which the queue raises to the row's frame.
  expect(got.slice(1).every(([f, b]) => f === 500 && b === 0xff)).toBe(true);
  expect(got.length).toBe(25);
});

test("MidiSyncArduinoboy: note 24 arms the clock behind a 0xFA bookend; note 25 stops it with 0xFC", () => {
  const rig = lsdj("midiSyncArduinoboy");
  expect(rig.run(beat())).toEqual([]); // idle: not playing, transport off
  // Note 24 arms play; transport rises this block → 0xFA first, then a full 24-tick clock (divisor 1).
  const started = rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 24)], { playing: true }));
  expect(serial(started)[0]).toBe(0xfa);
  expect(clocks(started)).toBe(24);
  // Still playing, transport already true → clock continues drift-free, no new bookend.
  const cont = rig.run(beat({ ppq: 1, playing: true }));
  expect(serial(cont).includes(0xfa)).toBeFalsy();
  expect(clocks(cont)).toBe(24);
  // Note 25 stops play; transport falls → a lone 0xFC bookend, no clock.
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 25)], { ppq: 2 })))).toEqual([0xfc]);
});

test("MidiSyncArduinoboy: tempo divisor subdivides the clock; note >= 30 pushes a raw row byte", () => {
  expect(clocks(lsdj("midiSyncArduinoboy", { tempoDivisor: 2 }).run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 24)], { playing: true })))).toBe(12);
  // note 40 → 40 - 30 = 10 (row passthrough is independent of the play flag).
  expect(serial(lsdj("midiSyncArduinoboy").run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 40)])))).toEqual([10]);
  // Notes 26-29 set the divisor (1, 2, 4, 8), which outlives a tempoDivisor edit, as the role's did.
  const rig = lsdj("midiSyncArduinoboy");
  rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 24), noteOn(0, 28)], { playing: true }));
  rig.set({ mode: "midiSyncArduinoboy", tempoDivisor: 1 });
  expect(clocks(rig.run(beat({ ppq: 1, playing: true })))).toBe(6);
});

test("KeyboardMidi: a note maps to its GB-serial-mangled PS/2 scancode; a cursor note gets the extended prefix", () => {
  const rig = lsdj("keyboardMidi");
  // note 48 (C-3 = NOTE_START): octave slides 4 → 0 (4× OCT_DN 0x05 → 0x50) then NOTE_MAP[0] 0x1A → 0x2C.
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 48)])))).toEqual([0x50, 0x50, 0x50, 0x50, 0x2c]);
  // note 40 (LOW_START 36 + 4 = Cursor Left 0x6B) → extended prefix 0xE0 → 0x03, then 0x6B → 0x6B.
  expect(serial(rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 40)])))).toEqual([0x03, 0x6b]);
});

test("the inbox is the routed MIDI, then the launches: a launch at frame 0 goes after a routed row at a later frame", () => {
  const sent = lsdj("midiMap").run({
    frames: 1024,
    inputs: { midi: [noteOn(0, 7, 600)], launches: [{ frame: 0, data: [0x90, 2, 100] }, { frame: 0, data: [0x80, 2, 0] }] },
  });
  // Row 7 at 600, then the launch's row 2 and its release's handshake, each raised to 600 by the queue.
  expect(bytesOn(sent, "serialIn")).toEqual([[600, 7], [600, 2], [600, 0xfe]]);
  expect(sent.map((s) => s.frame)).toEqual([600, 0]); // two runs: the row's, then the launch's at frame 0
});

test("serial-in bytes go a run of same-frame bytes to a message, each run sent before the next frame's", () => {
  // Arduinoboy, on the transport's rise: each note's row byte at its frame, then START at frame 0, a run of its own.
  const sent = lsdj("midiSyncArduinoboy").run({
    frames: 1024,
    playing: true,
    inputs: { midi: [noteOn(0, 30, 9), noteOn(0, 31, 9), noteOn(0, 40, 200)] },
  });
  expect(sent.filter((s) => s.port === "serialIn").map((s) => [s.frame, ...s.data])).toEqual([[9, 0, 1], [200, 10], [0, 0xfa]]);
});

test("a run a throw leaves is sent, and a run a stopped call left is never sent in a later block", () => {
  // No mode throws on what it accepts, so Math.ceil throws for the one value MidiMap's clock reaches when it first
  // syncs, at ppq 10.5 (tick 252), after the node has pushed the row byte it holds as a run.
  const rig = lsdj("midiMap");
  const ceil = Math.ceil;
  Math.ceil = (x: number) => {
    if (x === 252) throw new Error("injected");
    return ceil(x);
  };
  try {
    expect(() => rig.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 3, 4)], { frames: 1024, ppq: 10.5, playing: true }))).toThrow("injected");
  } finally {
    Math.ceil = ceil;
  }
  expect(rig.last.map((s) => [s.port, s.frame, ...s.data])).toEqual([["serialIn", 4, 3]]);

  // The deadline's stop skips the finally that sends the run. A send that throws stands in for it: the run is still
  // held when the call ends, and the next block starts from none.
  const stopped = lsdj("midiPassthrough");
  const run = stopped.run.bind(stopped);
  const node = stopped.node;
  const process = node.process.bind(node);
  node.process = (b) => {
    const send = b.send;
    b.send = () => {
      throw new Error("stopped");
    };
    try {
      return process(b);
    } finally {
      b.send = send;
    }
  };
  expect(() => run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 60, 4)], { frames: 1024 }))).toThrow("stopped");
  node.process = process;
  expect(run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 61, 7)], { frames: 1024 })).map((s) => [s.frame, ...s.data])).toEqual([[7, 0x90, 61, 100]]);
});

// --- MI.OUT (mode 7) and master sync (mode 8): the Game Boy's serial out, a block late ---------------------------------

test("MI.OUT: the serial-out bytes decode to host MIDI at frame 0, and nothing reaches serial in", () => {
  // A byte every eight frames, as SameBoy clocks MI.OUT's port (one bit an audio frame); each flag-frames one protocol
  // byte (0x80 | cmd): START, clock, NoteOn ch0 note 0x69.
  const framed = (cmd: number, frame: number): In => ({ frame, data: [0x80 | (cmd & 0x7f)] });
  const sent = lsdj("midiOut").run({ frames: 1024, inputs: { serialOut: [framed(0x7d, 7), framed(0x7f, 15), framed(0x70, 23), framed(0x69, 31)] } });
  expect(midiOut(sent)).toEqual([[0xfa], [0xf8], [0x90, 0x69, 0x7f]]);
  expect(sent.every((s) => s.port === "midiOut" && s.frame === 0)).toBe(true);
});

test("MI.OUT: a frame split across two blocks' bytes decodes once, its partial bits held between them", () => {
  const rig = lsdj("midiOut");
  expect(rig.run({ frames: 1024, inputs: { serialOut: [{ frame: 0, data: [0x7f] }] } })).toEqual([]);
  expect(midiOut(rig.run({ frames: 1024, inputs: { serialOut: [{ frame: 0, data: [0x80] }] } }))).toEqual([[0xf8]]);
});

test("master sync: each byte a clock, the first opening the run with LSDj's song row and 0xFA", () => {
  const sent = lsdj("masterSync").run({ frames: 1024, inputs: { serialOut: [{ frame: 0, data: [5] }, { frame: 900, data: [6] }] } });
  expect(midiOut(sent)).toEqual([[0x90, 5, 0x7f], [0xfa], [0xf8], [0xf8]]);
  expect(bytesOn(sent, "serialIn")).toEqual([]); // a pure decoder: no serial in
});

test("master sync times its stop from the byte's own frame, which only the feedback wire's frame can tell", () => {
  // A run's one byte at frame 0 or at frame 1000 of a 1024-frame block: the 0xFC goes out in the first block that
  // starts more than 200 ms (8820 frames) after the byte.
  const stopsIn = (frame: number) => {
    const rig = lsdj("masterSync");
    for (let b = 0; b < 16; b++) {
      const sent = rig.run({ frames: 1024, playing: true, inputs: b === 0 ? { serialOut: [{ frame, data: [5] }] } : {} });
      if (midiOut(sent).some((m) => m[0] === 0xfc)) return b;
    }
    return -1;
  };
  expect(stopsIn(0)).toBe(8); // the byte 1024 frames before block 0's start: 1024 + 8 * 1024 > 8820
  expect(stopsIn(1000)).toBe(9); // 24 frames before it: 24 + 9 * 1024 > 8820
});

test("leaving master sync drops its state, so coming back opens a fresh run", () => {
  const rig = lsdj("masterSync");
  const block = (serialOut: In[]) => midiOut(rig.run({ frames: 1024, inputs: { serialOut } }));
  expect(block([{ frame: 100, data: [5] }])).toEqual([[0x90, 5, 0x7f], [0xfa], [0xf8]]); // a run opens
  rig.set({ mode: "off" });
  block([]);
  rig.set({ mode: "masterSync" });
  // Kept, the stale open run would swallow this run's NoteOn and 0xFA.
  expect(block([{ frame: 0, data: [7] }])).toEqual([[0x90, 7, 0x7f], [0xfa], [0xf8]]);
});

// --- state across settings changes ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

test("a settings change keeps the clock: a mode change mid-run does not restart the tick count", () => {
  const rig = lsdj("midiSync");
  expect(clocks(rig.run(beat({ playing: true })))).toBe(24);
  rig.set({ mode: "midiMap" });
  // ppq stays 0, so a fresh counter would resync and send the same 24; one that kept its counter is past this quarter.
  expect(serial(rig.run(beat({ playing: true }))).length).toBe(0);
  expect(rig.creates).toBe(1);
});

test("a fresh instance starts fresh: the play flag clear, and the transport's first block a rising edge", () => {
  // The kernel pruned a removed system's scratch, so a re-added one started fresh; a new node is fresh by being new.
  const old = lsdj("midiSyncArduinoboy");
  old.run(withMidi([noteOn(0, 24)], { playing: true }));
  const out = lsdj("midiSyncArduinoboy").run(beat({ playing: true }));
  expect(clocks(out)).toBe(0);
  expect(serial(out).includes(0xfa)).toBeTruthy();
});
````

Create `packages/retroplug/test/script/nodes/controller-session.test.ts`:

````ts
// rp.controller.session (src/script/nodes/controllerSession.ts): a control surface's session, as the `launchpad` role
// ran it. The cases of test/dsp/controller-role.test.ts and test/controller/role.test.ts, which drive the role through
// the kernel, at the node: a pad press out as a launch (into an rp.lsdj.sync node's launches, through its real MI.MAP
// mode, or out of the host), LEDs on controllerOut, the device taken on its connect edge, and the re-push rules.
import { test, expect } from "../../../testing/harness";
import { CONTROLLER_SESSION_NODE_TYPE, controllerSessionNode } from "../../../src/script/nodes/controllerSession";
import { lsdjSyncNode } from "../../../src/script/nodes/lsdjSync";
import { ControllerRegistry, registerControllerApps } from "../../../src/controller";
import { songRowTicks } from "../../../src/lsdj/playback";
import { SongSchema } from "../../../src/lsdj/model";
import { PRO_MK3, Palette, enterProgrammerMode, padIndex } from "../../../src/launchpad";
import { NodeRig, bytesOn, type BlockSpec, type In, type Sent } from "./_rig";

// The control plane parses an app's config by the app's schema (the registry's); the node takes it parsed.
const apps = new ControllerRegistry();
registerControllerApps(apps);
const parsed = (appConfig: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => apps.get("lsdj-midimap")!.schema.parse(appConfig);

/** Sixteen rows, each one one-phrase chain: every row has content and lasts 96 ticks. */
const table = () =>
  songRowTicks(SongSchema.parse({ formatVersion: 22, rows: Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => ({ chains: [0, 0, 0, 0] })), chains: [{ phrases: [0] }] }));

/** A 4 x 256 tick table with content on rows 0 and 1 only. */
const twoRows = (): (number | null)[][] => [0, 1, 2, 3].map(() => Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, r) => (r < 2 ? 96 : null)));
/** The same song with a chain added to row 4, as an edit inside LSDj makes. */
const editedTwoRows = (): (number | null)[][] => {
  const t = twoRows();
  for (const ch of t) ch[4] = 96;
  return t;
};

const SYSTEM = 7;
const HELLO = enterProgrammerMode(PRO_MK3);

const settingsOf = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  app: "lsdj-midimap",
  target: "system",
  systemId: SYSTEM,
  songRowTicks: table(),
  appConfig: parsed(),
  ...over,
});
const session = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => new NodeRig(controllerSessionNode, settingsOf(over));

/** Press the pad showing (channel 0, row `row`) on page 0. Rows 0-7 are the left pane, 8-15 the right. */
const press = (row: number): In => ({ frame: 0, data: [0x90, padIndex({ x: row < 8 ? 0 : 4, y: row % 8 }), 100] });
const PRESS_ROW_0: In = { frame: 0, data: [0x90, 0x51, 0x7f] };

interface Step {
  ppq?: number;
  playing?: boolean;
  connected?: boolean;
  surface?: In[];
}
const blockOf = (step: Step, frames = 1024): BlockSpec => ({
  frames,
  ppq: step.ppq ?? 0,
  playing: step.playing ?? true,
  inputs: { controllerIn: step.surface ?? [] },
  controls: { controllerConnected: { start: step.connected ? 1 : 0, changes: [] } },
});

const at = (sent: Sent[], port: string): number[][] => sent.filter((s) => s.port === port).map((s) => s.data);
const sameBytes = (a: readonly number[] | undefined, b: readonly number[]): boolean =>
  !!a && a.length === b.length && a.every((v, i) => v === b[i]);

/** A session wired to an LSDj node in MI.MAP mode, its launches into the node's launches, one block at a time. */
class Wired {
  readonly controller: NodeRig<unknown>;
  readonly lsdj = new NodeRig(lsdjSyncNode, { mode: "midiMap" });
  constructor(over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
    this.controller = session(over) as NodeRig<unknown>;
  }
  run(step: Step, midi: In[] = []): { controller: Sent[]; lsdj: Sent[] } {
    const controller = this.controller.run(blockOf(step));
    const launches = controller.filter((s) => s.port === "launches").map((s) => ({ frame: s.queued, data: s.data }));
    const lsdj = this.lsdj.run({ ...blockOf(step), inputs: { midi, launches } });
    return { controller, lsdj };
  }
}
/** Row bytes only: the clock stream MI.MAP sends every tick would drown the signal. */
const rowBytes = (sent: Sent[]): number[] => bytesOn(sent, "serialIn").map(([, b]) => b).filter((b) => b !== 0xff && b !== 0xfe);

test("its ports: the surface in, its connected flag; the surface out, the launches and host MIDI out", () => {
  expect(session().ports()).toEqual([
    "in events controllerIn",
    "in control controllerConnected",
    "out events controllerOut",
    "out events launches",
    "out events midiOut",
  ]);
  expect(controllerSessionNode.descriptor().id).toBe(CONTROLLER_SESSION_NODE_TYPE);
  const caps = controllerSessionNode.layout(controllerSessionNode.parseSettings({})).ports.slice(2).map((p) => p.capacity);
  expect(caps).toEqual([{ messages: 256, bytes: 4096 }, { messages: 64, bytes: 256 }, { messages: 1024, bytes: 8192 }]);
  expect(controllerSessionNode.reshapes).toBe(true);
});

test("settings default as the role's did, and keep the parsed app config and the tables as given", () => {
  expect(controllerSessionNode.parseSettings({})).toEqual({
    app: "lsdj-midimap",
    target: "system",
    systemId: 0,
    appConfig: {},
    songRowTicks: [],
    anchorRows: [],
    anchorSeq: 0,
  });
  const given = {
    app: "lsdj-midimap",
    target: "midiOut",
    systemId: SYSTEM,
    appConfig: parsed({ quantise: "beat" }),
    songRowTicks: [[96, null], [96]],
    anchorRows: [1, null, 3, 4],
    anchorSeq: 2,
  };
  expect(controllerSessionNode.parseSettings(given)).toEqual(given);
  expect(() => controllerSessionNode.parseSettings({ target: "elsewhere" })).toThrow("target: Invalid option");
});

test("a pad press reaches the cart's link port, through the real MI.MAP mode, in one block", () => {
  const w = new Wired({ appConfig: parsed({ quantise: "immediate" }) });
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 0 }).lsdj)).toEqual([]); // nothing pressed yet
  const out = w.run({ ppq: 0.1, surface: [press(5)] });
  expect(at(out.controller, "launches")).toEqual([[0x90, 5, 100]]);
  expect(rowBytes(out.lsdj)).toEqual([5]);
});

test("the same launch stream goes to MIDI out instead, for a real Game Boy", () => {
  const w = new Wired({ target: "midiOut", appConfig: parsed({ quantise: "immediate" }) });
  w.run({});
  const out = w.run({ ppq: 0.1, surface: [press(5)] });
  expect(out.controller.filter((s) => s.port === "midiOut").map((s) => [s.frame, ...s.data])).toEqual([[0, 0x90, 5, 100]]);
  expect(at(out.controller, "launches")).toEqual([]); // and nothing went to the cart
  expect(rowBytes(out.lsdj)).toEqual([]);
});

test("control-surface traffic never reaches the cart as music", () => {
  // The same bytes on the cart's routed MIDI launch row 11 (the pad's note number), on the surface row 5.
  const w = new Wired({ appConfig: parsed({ quantise: "immediate" }) });
  w.run({});
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 0.1 }, [press(5)]).lsdj)).toEqual([padIndex({ x: 0, y: 5 })]);
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 0.2, surface: [press(5)] }).lsdj)).toEqual([5]);
});

test("quantisation is driven by the block clock, so a launch waits for the bar", () => {
  const w = new Wired(); // bar, the default: 96 ticks = 4 quarters
  w.run({ ppq: 4.0 });
  w.run({ ppq: 4.1, surface: [press(0)] }); // something playing, so the next press has a boundary to wait for
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 4.2, surface: [press(6)] }).lsdj)).toEqual([]); // cued, not launched
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 7.9 }).lsdj)).toEqual([]); // still short of the bar
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 8.0 }).lsdj)).toEqual([6]); // ppq 8 = tick 192
});

test("LED bytes come out on controllerOut at frame 0, not as launches or MIDI out", () => {
  const rig = session();
  const out = rig.run(blockOf({}));
  expect(at(out, "controllerOut").length > 0).toBeTruthy(); // the first paint
  expect(out.every((s) => s.port === "controllerOut" && s.frame === 0)).toBe(true);
  // A second identical block repaints the same grid, so the diffing surface sends nothing at all.
  expect(rig.run(blockOf({}))).toEqual([]);
});

test("the session survives across blocks, so cues and pages are not forgotten", () => {
  const w = new Wired();
  w.run({ ppq: 0 });
  w.run({ ppq: 0.1, surface: [press(0)] }); // immediate: nothing playing
  w.run({ ppq: 0.2, surface: [press(9)] }); // now cued
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 3.9 }).lsdj)).toEqual([]);
  expect(rowBytes(w.run({ ppq: 4.0 }).lsdj)).toEqual([9]);
});

test("an unknown app id runs nothing rather than throwing on the audio thread", () => {
  expect(session({ app: "does-not-exist" }).run(blockOf({ surface: [press(3)], connected: true }))).toEqual([]);
});

// --- taking the device -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const surface = (sent: Sent[]) => at(sent, "controllerOut");
const quiet = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => session({ songRowTicks: twoRows(), ...over });
const still = (step: Step = {}): BlockSpec => blockOf({ playing: false, ...step }, 512);

test("with no device attached the node never enters Programmer mode", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  expect(surface(rig.run(still())).some((m) => sameBytes(m, HELLO))).toBe(false);
  expect(surface(rig.run(still())).some((m) => sameBytes(m, HELLO))).toBe(false);
});

test("a device appearing mid-session is taken on that block, hello first", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  rig.run(still());
  rig.run(still());
  const out = surface(rig.run(still({ connected: true })));
  expect(out.length > 0).toBe(true);
  expect(sameBytes(out[0], HELLO)).toBe(true);
});

test("a surface counts as attached when it is from frame 0", () => {
  const sentToSurface = (connected: { start: number; changes: { frame: number; value: number }[] }) =>
    session().run({ frames: 1024, controls: { controllerConnected: connected } }).length;
  const unattached = sentToSurface({ start: 0, changes: [] });
  expect(unattached).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(sentToSurface({ start: 0, changes: [{ frame: 0, value: 1 }] })).toBeGreaterThan(unattached);
  expect(sentToSurface({ start: 1, changes: [] })).toBeGreaterThan(unattached);
  expect(sentToSurface({ start: 0, changes: [{ frame: 9, value: 1 }] })).toBe(unattached);
});

test("staying connected does not re-send hello every block", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  rig.run(still({ connected: true }));
  expect(surface(rig.run(still({ connected: true }))).some((m) => sameBytes(m, HELLO))).toBe(false);
});

test("a reconnect repaints the whole surface, not a diff against a device that was blanked", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  const painted = surface(rig.run(still({ connected: true }))).filter((m) => !sameBytes(m, HELLO));
  expect(painted.length > 0).toBe(true);
  rig.run(still({ connected: true }));
  expect(rig.run(still({ connected: true })).length).toBe(0);
  rig.run(still({ connected: false }));
  const again = surface(rig.run(still({ connected: true })));
  expect(sameBytes(again[0], HELLO)).toBe(true);
  expect(again.length - 1).toBe(painted.length);
});

test("the predictor keeps running while nothing is attached", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 0 }));
  const out = surface(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 8, connected: true }))); // 8 quarters = 192 ticks
  expect(sameBytes(out[0], HELLO)).toBe(true);
  expect(out.length > 1).toBe(true);
});

// --- reacting to a settings change -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Grid pad (x, y) -> device index. The device counts rows from the BOTTOM.
const pad = (x: number, y: number) => (7 - y) * 10 + x + 11;

/** A running model of what the device is showing, fed block by block: the surface sends only CHANGES. */
class Device {
  readonly leds = new Map<number, number>();
  feed(sent: Sent[]): void {
    for (const m of surface(sent)) {
      if (m[0] === 0xf0) {
        for (let i = 7; i + 2 < m.length - 1; i += 3) this.leds.set(m[i + 1], m[i + 2]);
      } else if ((m[0] & 0xf0) === 0x90 || (m[0] & 0xf0) === 0xb0) {
        this.leds.set(m[1], m[2]);
      }
    }
  }
  lit(x: number, y: number): boolean {
    const c = this.leds.get(pad(x, y));
    return c !== undefined && c !== 0;
  }
}

test("a song edited on the cart lights up in place, with no hello", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  const dev = new Device();
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ connected: true })));
  expect(rig.run(still({ connected: true })).length).toBe(0); // settled
  expect(dev.lit(0, 4)).toBe(false);
  expect(rig.set(settingsOf({ songRowTicks: editedTwoRows() }))).toBe(true);
  const out = rig.run(still({ connected: true }));
  dev.feed(out);
  expect(dev.lit(0, 4)).toBe(true);
  expect(surface(out).some((m) => sameBytes(m, HELLO))).toBe(false);
});

test("adopting a new song table does not restart the song", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  const dev = new Device();
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 0, connected: true, surface: [PRESS_ROW_0] })));
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 4, connected: true }))); // 96 ticks: row 0 -> row 1
  const playheadBefore = dev.leds.get(pad(0, 1));
  expect(playheadBefore !== undefined && playheadBefore !== 0).toBe(true);
  rig.set(settingsOf({ songRowTicks: editedTwoRows() }));
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 4, connected: true })));
  expect(dev.leds.get(pad(0, 1))).toBe(playheadBefore);
  expect(dev.lit(0, 4)).toBe(true);
});

test("an app knob changes behaviour on the next block", () => {
  const secondLaunchFires = (appConfig: Record<string, unknown>): boolean => {
    const rig = quiet();
    rig.set(settingsOf({ target: "midiOut", songRowTicks: twoRows(), appConfig: parsed(appConfig) }));
    rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 0, connected: true, surface: [PRESS_ROW_0] })); // starts it playing
    rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 1, connected: true }));
    // Now something IS playing, and tick 26 is nowhere near a bar line (96).
    return at(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 1.1, connected: true, surface: [PRESS_ROW_0] })), "midiOut").length > 0;
  };
  expect(secondLaunchFires({})).toBe(false); // bar (the default): the second press waits for the bar line
  expect(secondLaunchFires({ quantise: "immediate" })).toBe(true);
});

test("a rebuilt session re-takes the device rather than diffing against a surface it never painted", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  const first = surface(rig.run(still({ connected: true })));
  expect(sameBytes(first[0], HELLO)).toBe(true);
  rig.set(settingsOf({ songRowTicks: twoRows(), appConfig: parsed({ follow: false }) }));
  const out = surface(rig.run(still({ connected: true })));
  expect(sameBytes(out[0], HELLO)).toBe(true);
  expect(out.length).toBe(first.length);
});

test("a new target system rebuilds the session, as a new target did", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  rig.run(still({ connected: true }));
  rig.set(settingsOf({ songRowTicks: twoRows(), systemId: SYSTEM + 1 }));
  expect(sameBytes(surface(rig.run(still({ connected: true })))[0], HELLO)).toBe(true);
});

test("an anchor moves the playhead to where the cart actually started, once per sequence number", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  const dev = new Device();
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 0, connected: true, surface: [PRESS_ROW_0] })));
  expect(dev.lit(0, 0)).toBe(true); // predicted: row 0
  rig.set(settingsOf({ songRowTicks: twoRows(), anchorRows: [1, 1, 1, 1], anchorSeq: 1 }));
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 0.1, connected: true })));
  expect(dev.leds.get(pad(0, 1))).toBe(Palette.greenBright);
  expect(dev.leds.get(pad(0, 0))).toBe(Palette.greenDim);
  // The playhead advances a row on its own; an unrelated change arrives carrying the same anchor, which must not drag
  // it back.
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 4.1, connected: true }))); // +96 ticks: row 1 -> 0
  expect(dev.leds.get(pad(0, 0))).toBe(Palette.greenBright);
  rig.set(settingsOf({ songRowTicks: editedTwoRows(), anchorRows: [1, 1, 1, 1], anchorSeq: 1 }));
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 4.2, connected: true })));
  expect(dev.leds.get(pad(0, 0))).toBe(Palette.greenBright);
});

test("no anchor on the hardware path leaves dead reckoning exactly as it was", () => {
  const rig = quiet();
  const dev = new Device();
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 0, connected: true, surface: [PRESS_ROW_0] })));
  rig.set(settingsOf({ songRowTicks: twoRows(), anchorRows: [], anchorSeq: 0 }));
  dev.feed(rig.run(still({ playing: true, ppq: 0.1, connected: true })));
  expect(dev.leds.get(pad(0, 0))).toBe(Palette.greenBright);
});
````

Create `packages/retroplug/test/script/nodes/tick-clock.test.ts`:

````ts
// The tick walk (src/ticks.ts, the TS twin of native PpqUtil::eachTick) and a protocol node's clock over it
// (src/script/nodes/clock.ts). The expectations of test/dsp/each-tick.test.ts, which reads the walk through the kernel's
// re-export, here through its own module and through the clock a node keeps: a drift-free 24-PPQN clock, the boundary
// tick fired exactly once, a stopped transport firing none.
import { test, expect } from "../../../testing/harness";
import { walkTicks, type TickBlock } from "../../../src/ticks";
import { walkTicks as kernelWalkTicks } from "../../../src/dspKernel";
import { TickClock } from "../../../src/script/nodes/clock";
import type { Block } from "../../../src/graph/defineNode";

// 22050 frames @ 44100 Hz / 120 BPM = 0.5 s = exactly 1 beat → 24 ticks at 24 PPQN.
const tickBlock = (ppqStart: number, transport: boolean): TickBlock => ({ frames: 22050, sampleRate: 44100, tempo: 120, ppqStart, transport });
const block = (ppq: number, playing: boolean, frames = 22050): Block =>
  ({ frames, transport: { sampleRate: 44100, tempo: 120, ppq, playing } }) as Block;

test("the kernel's walkTicks is this one", () => {
  expect(kernelWalkTicks).toBe(walkTicks);
});

test("walkTicks emits a drift-free 24-PPQN clock (24 / 24 / 0 across two blocks + a stopped control)", () => {
  const b1: { t: number; o: number }[] = [];
  let nextTick = walkTicks(tickBlock(0, true), 24, 0, (t, o) => b1.push({ t, o }));
  expect(b1.length).toBe(24);
  expect(b1[0]).toEqual({ t: 0, o: 0 });
  expect(b1[23].t).toBe(23);
  expect(nextTick).toBe(24);

  const b2: number[] = [];
  nextTick = walkTicks(tickBlock(1.0, true), 24, nextTick, (t) => b2.push(t));
  expect(b2.length).toBe(24);
  expect(b2[0]).toBe(24);
  expect(b2[23]).toBe(47);
  expect(nextTick).toBe(48);

  const stopped: number[] = [];
  expect(walkTicks(tickBlock(2.0, false), 24, nextTick, (t) => stopped.push(t))).toBe(48);
  expect(stopped.length).toBe(0);
});

test("a node's clock carries its counter across blocks, as the kernel's per-system counter did", () => {
  const clock = new TickClock();
  const ticks: number[] = [];
  const record = (t: number) => ticks.push(t);
  clock.begin(block(0, true));
  expect(clock.block).toEqual(tickBlock(0, true));
  clock.walk(24, record);
  clock.begin(block(1, true));
  clock.walk(24, record);
  expect(ticks).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => i));
  expect(clock.next).toBe(48);
  clock.begin(block(2, false));
  clock.walk(24, record);
  expect(ticks.length).toBe(48);
});

test("a node's clock in 1-frame blocks fires each tick once, at the same ticks as one long block", () => {
  const clock = new TickClock();
  const ticks: number[] = [];
  for (let f = 0; f < 22050; f++) {
    clock.begin(block(f / 22050, true, 1));
    clock.walk(24, (t) => ticks.push(t));
  }
  expect(ticks).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i));
});

test("a walk a callback throws out of leaves the counter where it was", () => {
  const clock = new TickClock();
  clock.begin(block(0, true));
  expect(() =>
    clock.walk(24, (t) => {
      if (t === 3) throw new Error("stop");
    }),
  ).toThrow("stop");
  expect(clock.next).toBe(0);
});
````
